about: Scaling text design 2026-10-24 (Cayenne F-491, F-492). Real directions from the 2026-10-24 audit, cut to the steps that matter, no ids or owners. RecipeParser's core/count_tokens.py turns each case's `before` into its `after`; Cayenne's client renders `after`. Kept identical in both repositories (tests/fixtures/scaling_text_cases.json).

cases.name: Rich, Fudgy Brownies: all four of the eggs; Cut into 16 squares
before: Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to {{temp:350F,oven|350°F}}. Butter and {{ing_02|flour|none}} a {{pan_01|9-inch-square metal baking pan}}, tapping out the excess {{ing_02|flour|none}}.

Melt the {{ing_01|butter|all}} in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Remove the pan from the heat. Whisk or stir in the {{ing_03|sugar|all}}, followed by all four of the {{ing_04|eggs|none}} and the {{ing_05|vanilla|all}}.
Cut into 16 squares. Keep the brownies at room temperature, well wrapped. You can freeze them, too.
after: Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to {{temp:350F,oven|350°F}}. Butter and {{ing_02|flour|none}} a {{pan_01|9-inch-square metal baking pan}}, tapping out the excess {{ing_02|flour|none}}.

Melt the {{ing_01|butter|all}} in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Remove the pan from the heat. Whisk or stir in the {{ing_03|sugar|all}}, followed by all {{ing_04|four|4}} of the {{ing_04|eggs|none}} and the {{ing_05|vanilla|all}}.
Cut into {{yield:16|16}} squares. Keep the brownies at room temperature, well wrapped. You can freeze them, too.

cases.name: Tangy Lemon Bars: a yield count written as a word, a dimension before the noun
before: Lift the ends of the foil liner and transfer to a cutting board. Use a long sharp knife to cut into sixteen 2 inch bars.
after: Lift the ends of the foil liner and transfer to a cutting board. Use a long sharp knife to cut into {{yield:16|sixteen}} 2 inch bars.

after: Scrape the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide into {{yield:12|12}} pieces and roll each into a ball.
